caption: The drawing features five distinct black-and-white line illustrations on a beige background. In the top left corner, there is a horizontal decorative border or frieze with a flame-like motif at the top and layered horizontal lines beneath. Below this border, a small square panel depicts a stylized mask or face surrounded by an ornate frame. In the top right, there is a large, elaborate crest or coat of arms, which contains two creatures—a bear on the left and a bird on the right—divided by a central vertical line, with intricate swirling patterns around the shield and a lion-like figure above; the initials "C H" appear above the crest. Centered at the bottom left is a large circular plate or medallion with a broad rim decorated with swirling floral patterns and geometric shapes, enclosing a blank center with a small monogram or emblem bearing the letters "CK." On the right side, a tall, slender vase features horizontal bands and classical decorative patterns; the lower portion has a depiction of a lion-like creature in profile, and the upper portion is adorned with grooved and fluted ornamentation. The name "Lawrence Flynn" is written in cursive in the lower right corner. The composition is arranged to keep the objects distinct and separate from each other, each with clear lines and no shading.
title: Silver Tankard: Detail
